原文: After speaking to Amara at the Shrine of Ascension, to gain more power and change the world I need to obtain the essence of demigods. For the essence of Pahnu I need to travel to their temple in the desert.
译文: 在升华神殿与阿玛拉交谈后，我得知要想获得更强大的力量、改变这个世界，就必须取得半神的精华。而要得到帕赫努的精华，我得前往他们在沙漠中的神殿。

原文: All of Amhak's notes relate to a Dungeon on Mehden Island called Kab'Siron, we should head there to look for any clues.
译文: 阿姆哈克的所有笔记都指向梅登岛上名为卡布·西隆的地牢，我们应该去那里寻找线索。

原文: Amhak has been investigating clues relating to more Ritual Vessels, I should check with him and the Artefacts in his camp
译文: 阿姆哈克一直在调查更多仪式容器的线索，我应该去问他，并查看他营地里的器物。

原文: I've inspected Amhak's tomb findings and they all point to one location - Kab'Siron, I should speak to him about it.
译文: 我已查看阿姆哈克的墓穴发现，它们都指向同一个地点——卡布·西隆，我应该和他谈谈。

原文: I've met up with Amhak outside the Taberna, I should find out if he has any clues relating to more Vessels.
译文: 我在酒馆外与阿姆哈克会合了，应该问问他是否有更多容器的线索。

原文: The mysterious woman told me about the artifact she used to teleport herself to The Shrine of Ascension. Apparently a karrow bird flew off with it, but if I find it, I can keep it.
译文: 那位神秘女子告诉我，她用一件器物把自己传送到了升华神殿。据说一只卡萝鸟把它叼走了，但如果我找到它，就可以留下。

原文: The most numerous of the multiple feline species that can be found across Sabu, Felians are a humanoid cat-like race that shares many traits with the Carak people of the plains. Felians are primarily bipedal by nature, though some more primitive subspecies are known to run on all fours when hunting.
译文: 费利安人是萨布各地众多猫科种族中数量最多的一支，外形似人而具猫的特征，与平原上的卡拉克人有诸多相似之处。他们天生以双足行走，但已知有一些更原始的亚种在狩猎时会四肢并用。

原文: Void is the most common mode through which sorcery is wielded. It was not always this way, but since the introduction of Kethra into the realm and the ensuing meddling by the Daughters of the Void, it has been so.
译文: 虚空是施展法术最常见的途径。起初并非如此，但自凯斯拉降临此界、虚空之女随之插手以来，便成了如今的模样。

原文: "Beware the Cursed Ones, for their unmet lusts have seen Kethra's curse twist them into hungry, mindless monsters who, until their death, desire only to kill."
译文: “当心那些被诅咒者——未得满足的欲望让凯斯拉的诅咒将他们扭曲成饥渴而无知的怪物，至死只余杀意。”

原文: "Sorcery has always been present in Sabu, but even amongst demi-gods, only a rare few have ever wielded it with authority."
译文: “法术始终存在于萨布，但即便在半神之中，也只有极少数人能真正驾驭它。”

原文: "My name is Kethra, God Queen of Lust;
"None have yet to sight Kethra since her return, but her renewed presence has been harshly felt throughout Sabu nevertheless."
译文: “自凯斯拉归来，尚无人见过她的身影，但她重现的气息已让整个萨布为之震动。”

原文: "Yellow fruit is a staple in the Sabuthi diet. It's a wonder it hasn't been given a more proper name."
译文: “黄色果实是萨布提人的主食。奇怪的是它至今没得到一个更体面的名字。”

原文: A relatively rare subtype of Lesser Canid, Jackals are found with surprising frequency in positions of power and wealth throughout Sabu. Despite belonging to the same family as other Lesser Canids the Jackals are seen as a distinct people, primarily due to their physical likeness to the Demigod Anubis. A Jackal's keen hearing and extraordinary sense of smell make them naturally effective at detecting stealthy opponents, whilst their association with Anubis benefits their charisma and aids them in leading others. An obsession with maintaining the purity of the bloodline means that Jackals are particularly inbred and that no significant subtypes exist.
译文: 胡狼人是小型犬科中相当罕见的一支，却在萨布各地的权贵之中出人意料地常见。虽与其他小型犬科同源，胡狼人却被视为一个独特的族群，主要因为他们外形酷似半神阿努比斯。胡狼人听觉敏锐、嗅觉出众，天生擅长察觉潜行的对手；而与阿努比斯的渊源又增益了他们的魅力，有助于领导他人。对血统纯正的执念使他们近亲繁衍严重，因而没有明显的亚种分化。

原文: Adjusts midtone brightness without affecting contrast.
译文: 调整中间调亮度，不影响对比度。

原文: Adjusts the angle of vision for a wider or narrower view.
译文: 调整视野角度，以获得更宽或更窄的视野。

原文: An Anubite priestess named Amansi has asked me to look for Amhak, her 'dimwitted half-brother'. There must be someone around here who knows where he went...
译文: 一位名叫阿曼西的阿努比斯女祭司让我去找阿姆哈克，她那“脑子不太灵光的弟弟”。这附近应该有人知道他去了哪儿……

原文: I can hear some odd noises coming from a nearby pot, is someone stuck?
译文: 我听到旁边的罐子里传出怪声，是有人被困住了吗？

原文: I should bring these notes back to the farmer, but what should I tell him?
译文: 我应该把这些笔记带回去给农夫，可我该怎么跟他说？

原文: I spoke with Amhak's servant who told me Amhak went to explore some nearby ruins, a tomb called 'Kab'Sehet'. I should make my way there.
译文: 我和阿姆哈克的仆人谈过，他说阿姆哈克去探索附近的废墟了，一座叫“卡布·塞赫特”的墓穴。我该动身去那里。

原文: I've acquired an Aadi on trial from Hakor, if I pay him 1,000 gold, I can get the mount as my very own.
译文: 我从哈科尔那儿得到了一只在试用期的阿迪。只要付他 1,000 金币，这坐骑就归我了。

原文: I've been tasked to find a farmer's son and fieldhand who have a habit of sneaking off. They can't have gone too far.
译文: 我受托去寻找农夫的儿子和一个习惯偷溜出门的田工。他们应该还没走远。

原文: I've discovered a helpless but clearly aroused stranger trapped inside a pot, I should see what I can do to help, maybe I can get hold of some Fish Oil from a vendor..
译文: 我发现一个无助却明显动情的陌生人被困在罐子里。我该想想怎么帮她，也许能从商人那里弄到些鱼油……

原文: I've found a camp not too far from the farmer's land, perhaps this is where they snuck off to. I should have a look around.
译文: 我在离农夫的土地不远处发现了一处营地，也许他们就是溜到这儿来了。我该四处看看。

原文: I've found a note from a stablemaster on Tal'Senet, he's gone to Medhen island, if I find them, I can buy my own Aadi.
译文: 我在塔尔·塞奈特找到一位马厩主留下的字条，他去了梅登岛。如果能找到他们，我就能买下自己的阿迪。

原文: I've found Amhak, but he's trapped. I should eliminate the enemies keeping him trapped.
译文: 我找到阿姆哈克了，但他被困住了。我该消灭困住他的敌人。

原文: I've found Hakor, I should see about acquiring my own steed.
译文: 我找到哈科尔了，该去设法弄一匹自己的坐骑。

原文: I've found Kab'Sehet. Amhak must be within. I should have a look around.
译文: 我找到卡布·塞赫特了。阿姆哈克一定在里面。我该四处看看。

原文: I've managed to find some Fish Oil, let's see if this can help get her lubed up and out of the pot.
译文: 我弄到了一些鱼油，看看能不能帮她润滑一下、从罐子里出来。

原文: I've successfully saved Amhak. I should check in on him back at the Anubite camp.
译文: 我成功救出了阿姆哈克。我该回阿努比斯营地看看他。

原文: It seems Amhak's other half-sister, Astari, would like a word with me.
译文: 看来阿姆哈克的另一个妹妹阿斯塔里想和我谈谈。

原文: It would seem the Anubites are causing Safiya great distress. I should look into it. Maybe I can negotiate a peace between them.
译文: 看来阿努比斯人给萨菲娅带来了很大困扰。我该去查一查，也许能在他们之间促成和解。

译文: 现在阿姆哈克想和我谈谈，想必是要道谢。能帮上忙的感觉真好。

译文: 达玛丽斯告诉我，梅登岛上也许有位铁匠能取下我的面具，我该去那里找他。

原文: I've communed with the shrine. I should speak to the mysterious woman now.
译文: 我已与神殿沟通。现在该和那位神秘女子谈谈了。

原文: Kehm Farmstead is swarming with foes. I must defeat them.
译文: 凯姆农庄到处都是敌人。我必须击败他们。

译文: 一块浸了油的粗布缠在结实的木柄上，能在黑暗中照明。用环形菜单装备，或在游戏中按键盘 [Y]。

译文: 来自尤弗里斯河的鲜活生命之水，可用于调制药剂。

译文: 野兽散发恶臭的内脏。吃东西前记得洗手。用于制作。

译文: 结实、轻便，前主人已经用不上了。用于制作。

原文: An ornate shield featuring engravings said to depict the bright Sabuthi sunrise.
译文: 一面华丽的盾牌，上面的雕纹据说描绘着萨布提明亮的日出。

原文: A purer, rare batch of Osirup.
译文: 一批更纯净、稀有的奥西鲁普。

原文: An elixir prized by those wishing to appear more beguiling. Or maybe it just makes your breath smell good.
译文: 一种备受追求魅力者推崇的药剂。又或者它只是让你的口气变清新。

原文: This slimy, stamina-boosting elixir glows softly within its bottle.
译文: 这瓶黏滑的耐力增益药剂在瓶中微微发光。

原文: A brutal edge that tears through flesh and bone, spilling blood with every strike.
译文: 锋利的凶刃，能撕裂血肉与骨骼，每一击都鲜血四溅。

原文: A common enough but comfortable garment.
译文: 一件寻常但舒适的衣物。

原文: This intricately wired collection of gilded beads is synonymous with members of the Jackal Cult. The design of the garment ensures that no erogenous zone is obsucred, enabling maximum access for the pleasurable rituals of the Anubites.
译文: 这串工艺繁复的镀金珠饰是胡狼教成员的标志。这种设计确保没有任何敏感部位被遮挡，便于阿努比斯人进行享乐仪式。

原文: These two metal straps form part of a high-status slave outfit. The built-in rings allow for the wearer to be pinned into all manner of poses.
译文: 这两条金属束带是高等奴隶装束的一部分。内置的环扣可将穿戴者固定成各种姿势。

原文: The richly-adorned, linen skirt of an Anubite Warrior.
译文: 阿努比斯战士华丽的亚麻短裙。

原文: An ancient helm handed down from one generation of Centaur to the next over centuries.
译文: 一顶古老的头盔，数百年来在半人马一族中世代相传。

原文: The loose fitting clothing of a Jackal Cult Priestess. Large cutouts allow access for "rituals".
译文: 胡狼教女祭司的宽松衣袍。大幅镂空便于进行“仪式”。

原文: A common enough but comfortable garment. Worn by citizens and sopranos alike.
译文: 一件寻常但舒适的衣物。平民与歌唱家都穿它。

原文: This uncomfortable looking outfit indicates the wearer is a high-value slave of the Gilded Fold. The plates and straps bind tightly to the wearer without restricting movement.
译文: 这套看着就不舒服的装束表明穿戴者是镀金折笼的高价奴隶。甲片与束带紧贴身体，却不影响活动。

原文: Native AA acts as a premium Anti-Aliasing mode, rendering at full resolution to provide the sharpest image possible without shimmering. The quality presets render the game at lower internal resolutions and use AI to reconstruct the detail, significantly boosting your frame rate while maintaining high visual fidelity.
译文: Native AA 是一种高级抗锯齿模式，以完整分辨率渲染，提供最锐利的画面且无闪烁。画质预设会以较低的内部渲染分辨率运行游戏，再用 AI 重建细节，在保持高画质的同时显著提升帧率。

原文: Uses advanced GPU technology to generate additional frames between rendered frames, increasing perceived smoothness and frame rate. May increase latency or introduce visual artifacts depending on hardware and settings. It is recommended to be used together with a Latency Reduction method.

原文: The typical green-brown drab scales of the reptilian predators who call the Euphoris River their home.
译文: 以尤弗里斯河为家的爬行掠食者那种典型的灰绿褐色鳞片。

原文: This tiny fish has rough, sandy scales, and tastes like dirt. But it's packed with Omega-3 fatty acids!
译文: 这种小鱼鳞片粗糙带沙，尝起来像泥土。但富含 Omega-3 脂肪酸！

原文: These short clusters of horns are common among the cave-dwelling draconids of the far southern deserts.
译文: 这种短簇犄角在极南沙漠的穴居龙人中很常见。

原文: The vivid, red scales of a common Draconid. The pigmentation is drawn from an ancient and noble bloodline.
译文: 普通龙人鲜艳的红色鳞片。其色素源自一支古老而高贵的血脉。

原文: The iconic patterned fur of the forest-dwelling Felian subtype, affording ideal camoflage for stalking prey.
译文: 森林费利安亚种标志性的花纹毛皮，为潜行狩猎提供理想伪装。

原文: The round, white berries of this brambling plant have a bitter, salty taste, and are said to aid in verility.
译文: 这种荆棘植物的圆形白色浆果味道又苦又咸，据说有助于雄风。

原文: The iconic patterned fur of the savannah-dwelling Felian subtype, affording ideal camoflage for stalking prey.
译文: 草原费利安亚种标志性的花纹毛皮，为潜行狩猎提供理想伪装。

原文: The iconic patterned fur of the mountain-dwelling Felian subtype, affording ideal camoflage for stalking prey.
译文: 山地费利安亚种标志性的花纹毛皮，为潜行狩猎提供理想伪装。

原文: This perennial herb with pale-blue flowers is prized by the Sabuthi for the sweet liquid extracted from it's roots.
译文: 这种开淡蓝色花的多年生草本，因根部可提取甜液而受萨布提人珍视。

原文: The pale, unpigmented scales of those rare crocodilians that lurk in the subterranean lakes beneath the sands of Sabu.
译文: 潜伏在萨布沙下暗湖中的稀有鳄类那苍白无色的鳞片。

原文: The ragged hide of a large reptile. Somehow devoid of blood, pre-tanned and neatly rolled up. It even came with straps.
译文: 大型爬行动物的破烂皮革。不知为何毫无血迹，已预先鞣制并整齐卷好，甚至还附了束带。

原文: Ideally suited to underwater hunting, these sea-green scales originate from Draconid subtypes found dwelling in coastal regions.
译文: 这些海绿色鳞片极适合水下狩猎，来自栖居沿海地区的龙人亚种。

原文: When ripe, the heads of this stalky, semi-aquatic plant become a ball of cottony fluff. It's leaves are said to aid in fertility.
译文: 成熟时，这种茎秆粗壮半水生植物的头部会变成一团棉絮。据说其叶片有助于生育。

原文: These knife-like teeth once belonged to some predatory beast. Now they're yours. Like some perverse Tooth-Fairy. Used in crafting.
译文: 这些刀般的牙齿曾属于某种掠食野兽。现在是你的了——就像个变态的牙仙。用于制作。

原文: These curled horns are typical of various plains-dwelling draconids. They also grant a striking look and a devil may care attitude.
译文: 这种卷曲犄角是多种平原龙人的典型特征，也能带来抢眼的外形与满不在乎的气场。

原文: An average set of rear-facing horns, swept back from the top of the skull. Horns of this type are common among many Draconid subtypes.
译文: 一副普通的后向犄角，自头顶向后掠去。这类犄角在许多龙人亚种中都很常见。

原文: A reminder to never linger on an argument with a loved one, for death could come unexpectedly, stealing the opportunity for conciliation.
译文: 它提醒人们不要与所爱之人争执不休——死亡可能不期而至，夺走和解的机会。

原文: As white as alabaster, these scales belong to the rare Draconid subtype found only above the cloudline in the eponymous mountain range. .
译文: 这些如雪花石膏般洁白的鳞片属于一种稀有龙人亚种，只在同名山脉的云线之上才能见到。

原文: Well suited to the primordial swamp, these scales remain from a ancient reptilian bloodline that predates that of most Drakes and Draconids.
译文: 这些鳞片适应原始沼泽，来自一支比绝大多数龙与龙人都更古老的爬行血脉。

原文: Whether particularly rare or simply an exceptionally timid Draconid subtype, these dark, shimmering scales are almost unique in all of Sabu.
译文: 无论是格外稀有，还是仅仅因为这种龙人亚种异常胆怯，这些深色闪光的鳞片在整个萨布都几乎独一无二。

原文: Though this Amulet appears to be ordinary, Mered claimed it hummed with energy and power when he knew he needed to end a life. You sense nothing.
译文: 这枚护符看似普通，但梅瑞德说，当他意识到必须取人性命时，它会随能量与力量嗡鸣。而你什么也感觉不到。

原文: Once thought to be immune to fire, these very rare Draconids were driven to near extinction by a rutheless warlord who sought to test that theory.
译文: 这些极稀有的龙人曾被认为免疫火焰，一位想验证此说的残暴军阀几乎将他们灭绝。

原文: The loose fitting clothing of a Jackal Cult Priestess of the "Broodmare" chapter. These priestesses seek an endless cycle of impregnation and birth.
译文: “母马”分支胡狼教女祭司的宽松衣袍。这些女祭司追求受孕与生育的无尽循环。

原文: Milked from the penis of a blue dragon, this tonic, despite its colour, feels cool and tastes like a white strawberry magnum. Its been known to make the user a bit rigid.
译文: 取自蓝龙阳具的补剂，尽管色泽如此，入口却清凉，尝起来像白草莓雪糕。据说会让使用者变得有点僵硬。

原文: This ancient fragment of papyrus seems to detail the steps in the distillation of some obscure potion. Some of the ingredients seem common enough, others are either fictional or extremely rare.
译文: 这片古老的纸莎草残卷似乎记载着某种冷门药剂的蒸馏步骤。其中一些材料相当常见，另一些则要么纯属虚构，要么极其罕见。

原文: These carefully placed studs and rings help to better tether the void daughter to the mortal realm. The bindings allow them to more fully experience time and other physical sensations of the material world.
译文: 这些精心安放的钉与环能更好地将虚空之女系于凡界。束带让她们得以更充分地体验时间，以及物质世界的其他感官。

原文: A practical hairstyle with little decoration or flair. Plaits are worn by many whose forms sport long enough hair. The distinctive coiled locks are commonly seen in the streets and alleyways of smaller settlements.
译文: 一种实用、几无装饰与花巧的发型。许多头发够长的形态都会编这种辫子，那独特的盘卷发辫常见于小聚落的街巷。

原文: These ornate piercings reflect the crest of the merchant's guild, the Minoan-run monopoly. Originally worn solely by those unlucky enough to become the "livestock" of the guild, they have long since become a fashion symbol in some circles. They now serve as a shorthand for the debauchery and sexual availability of the wearer.
译文: 这些华丽穿孔呈现商人公会的徽记——那是米诺斯人垄断的组织。最初只有不幸沦为公会“牲口”的人才会佩戴，如今早已在某些圈子里成为时尚象征，也成为佩戴者放荡与性可得的代名词。

原文: Whether native to Sabu or brought from elsewhere, many human peoples can be found living in the kingdom of the God Queen. Their complexion and features may vary, but all humans are descended from a single ancestral bloodline. Lacking the natural weapons or defences of the other races, the true power of humans comes from their ability to adapt and rise together as one. Many creation myths hold that humans are predisposed to temptation, a trait that ensures few humans shy away from the path of ascension.
译文: 无论是萨布的原住民还是来自他方，神后之国度里都聚居着众多人类族群。他们的肤色与容貌各有不同，但所有人类都源自同一支血脉。人类没有其他种族天生的武器与防御，真正的力量来自他们随遇而安、团结共进的能力。许多创世神话认为人类天生易于受诱惑——正因如此，很少有人在升华之路上退却。

原文: The origins of the Void Daughters and other dwellers of the void, if they exist at all, are shrouded in mystery. Rituals are rumoured to exist that allow the passage of such beings into this reality, such creatures are said only to reside in the physical world by the use of enchanted bindings. Legend suggests that Void Daughters draw power from realms beyond ours, manipulating space and time. A single fragment of an antediluvian tome made the entirely unsubstantiated claim that Void Daughters could consume the souls of other beings. These are likely, however, to be mere fabrications of primitive peoples seeking to scare one another beside the campfire.
译文: 虚空之女与其他虚空居民（如果它们真的存在）的来历笼罩在迷雾之中。传说存在能让这类存在进入现实的仪式，而它们据说只能借附魔束带停留在物质世界。传说虚空之女从我们之外的领域汲取力量，操纵空间与时间。一册上古残卷中有一句毫无根据的说法，称虚空之女能吞噬其他存在的灵魂。不过这些很可能只是原始民族围坐篝火互相吓唬时编造的故事。

原文: Found in all towns and villages throughout Sabu, the formless occupy the lowest possible rung in the social ladder. With no marks of the goddess to speak of, their very appearance is taboo. The wraps and mask which cover the formless are woven with enchantments, preventing their removal by the wearer. Only a powerful release of essence, or extensive rituals, can otherwise rid the formless of their bindings.
译文: 无形者遍布萨布的大小城镇与村落，处在社会阶梯的最底层。他们身上没有丝毫女神的印记，光是这副模样便已是禁忌。覆盖无形者的缠布与面具织入了附魔，佩戴者自己无法取下。唯有强大的精华释放，或繁复的仪式，才能让他们摆脱束缚。

译文: 这是所悬停物品的描述。

译文: 将鼠标悬停在物品上以查看描述。

原文: Aspect of the Human I am a human

Not a true species at all, Demi-Felians are one of several human subtypes. Having insufficient essence to ascend to a greater form, these peoples have sewn shards of essence into simple neckwear. The Lybossan patterns embossed upon the collar hint at the origins of the magics used to sustain the limited transformation. A Demi-Felian lacks most of the agility of it’s parent species whilst retaining almost all of their human vulnerabilities. Their first step towards ascension does make owning them as slaves somewhat taboo however, meaning that they often avoid the clutches of the slave traders cartel.
译文: 严格来说，他们根本算不上一个真正的物种——半费利安人是若干人类亚种之一。由于精华不足以升格为更高的形态，这些人把精华碎片缝进简陋的颈饰之中。项圈上压印的利博桑纹样，暗示着维系这种有限变形所用魔法的由来。半费利安人失去了母种的大部分敏捷，却几乎保留了人类所有的脆弱之处。不过，迈出升格的第一步也让他们在奴隶交易中略显犯忌，因此这些人往往能躲开奴隶贩子集团的手掌。

原文: Not a true species at all, Demi-Draconids are one of several human subtypes. Having insufficient essence to ascend to a greater form, these peoples have sewn shards of essence into simple neckwear. The Lybossan patterns embossed upon the collar hint at the origins of the magics used to sustain the limited transformation. A Demi-Draconid lacks most of the hardened scales of it’s parent species whilst retaining almost all of their human vulnerabilities. Their first step towards ascension does make owning them as slaves somewhat taboo however, meaning that they often avoid the clutches of the slave trader's cartel.
译文: 严格来说，他们根本算不上一个真正的物种——半龙人是若干人类亚种之一。由于精华不足以升格为更高的形态，这些人把精华碎片缝进简陋的颈饰之中。项圈上压印的利博桑纹样，暗示着维系这种有限变形所用魔法的由来。半龙人失去了母种的大部分硬化鳞甲，却几乎保留了人类所有的脆弱之处。不过，迈出升格的第一步也让他们在奴隶交易中略显犯忌，因此这些人往往能躲开奴隶贩子集团的手掌。

原文: A vanishingly rare race in Sabu, Crocodilians are never found far from the banks of the Euphoris river. A particularly primal race, Crocodilians are more closely aligned to their kin species than other peoples of the desert kingdom. This closeness to their animal kin has led to Crocodilians being referred to simply as ‘Crocodiles’ in common parlance. A Crocodilian is unmatched in the water, being both a naturally capable swimmer and capable of holding their breath for an extended duration. Their cold-blooded nature often dictates their station, known for being particularly capable at concealing their emotions.
译文: 在萨布，鳄人是极为罕见的一支，他们从不远离尤弗里斯河的河岸。作为格外原始的一支种族，鳄人与自己的兽类亲族，比沙漠王国的其他族群更为亲近。这种亲近，让他们在日常口语中干脆被叫作“鳄鱼”。鳄人在水中无人能敌——既是天生的游泳好手，也能长时间屏住呼吸。冷血的习性常常左右他们的处境，他们以极善于掩藏情绪而闻名。

原文: Not a true species at all, Demi-Jackals are one of several human subtypes. Having insufficient essence to ascend to a greater form, these peoples have sewn shards of essence into simple neckwear. The Lybossan patterns embossed upon the collar hint at the origins of the magics used to sustain the limited transformation. A Demi-Jackal lacks most of the enhanced senses of it’s parent species whilst retaining almost all of their human vulnerabilities. Their first step towards ascension and shared likeness with Anubis makes owning them as slaves very taboo, however this taboo itself is enough to make them particularly sought after in secret auctions held by the slave traders cartel.
译文: 严格来说，他们根本算不上一个真正的物种——半胡狼人是若干人类亚种之一。由于精华不足以升格为更高的形态，这些人把精华碎片缝进简陋的颈饰之中。项圈上压印的利博桑纹样，暗示着维系这种有限变形所用魔法的由来。半胡狼人失去了母种大部分的敏锐感官，却几乎保留了人类所有的脆弱之处。迈出升格的第一步、以及与阿努比斯相似的外貌，使拥有他们作奴隶极为犯忌——而这份犯忌本身，又让他们在奴隶贩子集团举办的秘密拍卖中格外抢手。

译文: 以苏巴克之眼调制而成的灵药，饮下者的皮肤会在短时间内坚硬如石。

原文: Temporal Super Resolution, a high-quality upscaler built directly into the game engine. Works on all graphics cards. It provides a reliable balance of performance and stability without requiring specific hardware or third-party drivers.
译文: 时间超分辨率（TSR），直接内建于引擎的高质量升频技术。支持所有显卡，无需特定硬件或第三方驱动，即可稳定兼顾性能与画质。

原文: Intel XeSS 2, an advanced AI-based upscaler designed for high motion clarity. Works on almost all modern GPUs. While optimized for Intel Arc and the latest Core Ultra processors, it provides an excellent AI-driven alternative for NVIDIA GTX and AMD Radeon users.
译文: Intel XeSS 2，基于 AI 的先进升频技术，专为高动态清晰度设计，几乎所有现代 GPU 都可用。虽针对 Intel Arc 与最新 Core Ultra 处理器优化，也为 NVIDIA GTX 与 AMD Radeon 用户提供了出色的 AI 升频方案。

原文: AMD FSR Redstone has universal compatibility. The cutting-edge AI features are optimized for the Radeon RX 9000 series, while owners of older Radeon, NVIDIA, or integrated graphics will automatically use the highly-compatible analytical fallback.
译文: AMD FSR Redstone 具备通用兼容性。前沿 AI 特性针对 Radeon RX 9000 系列优化，而较旧的 Radeon、NVIDIA 或集成显卡用户将自动使用兼容性极佳的解析式回退方案。

原文: NVIDIA DLSS 4.5 uses a state-of-the-art AI Transformer model to reconstruct ultra-sharp images. Requires an NVIDIA GeForce RTX GPU. Owners of RTX 20 and 30 series cards will automatically use the high-fidelity compatibility model, while RTX 40 and 50 series benefit from the latest hardware acceleration.
